cases.name: KNOWN-LIMIT-overlong-track-label-overflows-rail
cases.why: Records a deliberate limit: the label rail is a fixed 120 px because SVG cannot measure text, so a label past ~18 characters spills over its content. Callers must pass short track labels (the web gene page passes '基因 (+)'); the full accession belongs in the feature label and the page heading.
